description: Implementation of SemaphoreGL class for OpenGL synchronization, including methods for importing file descriptors, waiting, and signaling semaphores, as well as utility functions for gathering buffer and texture IDs.

classes.name: SemaphoreGL
classes.description: A class managing an OpenGL semaphore object, providing methods for import, wait, signal, and destruction.

methods.name: SemaphoreGL
methods.description: Constructor initializing the semaphore with an ID.

methods.name: ~SemaphoreGL
methods.description: Destructor asserting semaphore ID is zero.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Deletes the semaphore using OpenGL functions.

methods.name: importFd
methods.description: Imports a file descriptor into the semaphore.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits on the semaphore with specified buffer and texture barriers.

methods.name: signal
methods.description: Signals the semaphore with specified buffer and texture barriers.
